headlines.title: Does Beating The Market Prove Arista Is A Great Company?
headlines.summary: Arista Networks (ANET) sells the network switches that link computers together. Its stock has outpaced the S&P 500 for five consecutive years. Investors often view a record like that as evidence of an exceptional business. Out of about 480 large U.S. stocks, how many would you guess did the same.

headlines.title: Arista Networks (ANET) Stock Dropped, What Is Behind The Fresh Attention?
headlines.summary: Arista Networks (ANET) has put high-density AI infrastructure at the center of its story with a new open Ethernet rack-scale portfolio, aiming to link accelerators across liquid-cooled racks for large-scale workloads. The latest AI rack-scale launch lands after a strong run in Arista Networks’ shares, with the stock up 15.51% on a 90-day share price return and 57.84% year to date, while long-term total shareholder return over five years is about 8x. description: Arista Networks, Inc. engages in the development, marketing, and sale of data-driven, client to cloud networking solutions for AI, data center, campus, and routing environments in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia-Pacific. Its cloud networking solutions consist of Extensible Operating System (EOS), a publish-subscribe state-sharing networking operating system offered in combination with a set of network applications. The company offers data center, cloud and AI networking, cognitive adjacencies, and cognitive network software and services. It also provides post contract customer support services, such as technical support, hardware repair and replacement parts beyond standard warranty, bug fixes, patches, and upgrade services. The company serves a range of industries comprising internet companies, cloud service providers, financial services organizations, government agencies, media and entertainment, healthcare, oil and gas, education, manufacturing, industrial, and others. It markets and sells its products through distributors, system integrators, value-added resellers, and original equipment manufacturer partners, as well as through its direct sales force. Arista Networks, Inc. was formerly known as Arastra, Inc. and changed its name to Arista Networks, Inc. in October 2008. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
